d:
Kendriy vitt mantri nirmala sitarman ne apne vishesh lekh men bataya hai ki kaise pichhle ek dashak men sarkari yojnaon, vittiy samaveshan aur mahila sashaktikran ke jarie bharat men garibi kam karne ki disha men mahatvapurn pragti huee hai. sath hi, 2047 tak viksit bharat banne ke lakshy par bhi jor diya hai.
Thank you for watching our video!
